statement: This sketch renders an expansive arid desert landscape using p5.js, with a dominant terracotta earth tone palette against a contrasting beige sky. The composition features heavily textured ground with sharply defined cracks into which lighter sediment has settled. Sparsely placed acacia trees provide occasional relief from the flat terrain. The key animation comes from numerous dust devils that drift organically across the cracked surface, continuously animating the static desert environment. Using a fixed number of pre-generated elements and simple physics-based movement, the sketch creates an immersive yet computationally efficient desert scene that evolves naturally over time without user input.
